html: A how to cite page gives citation text for the specification, the registry dataset and the question bank, each with its version, date, address and licence, and the registry's single-rater caveat. It says plainly that no DOI has been issued and that registry version 0.9.0 was changed in place on 19 November 2026. The repository now has a CITATION.cff and a .zenodo.json built from the same source, so a future tagged release can be archived; neither claims a DOI.
